verdicts.reason: A rearranges the design: large three-line headline with the blue/black colour split intact, and two aligned boxes below as a clear group. Flaws: the headline sits on the busy image, its end clips the pillar, and a decorative ball is cut at the left edge. The boxes are small with dead space beneath them, and the boxes sit on the busy photo. B is a stretched copy of the banner: the headline is small and runs flush to the left edge with its 'C' cropped, so it is not a rearrangement. The blue and black boxes are staggered and misaligned, the black box touches the right edge, and the bottom half of the canvas is dead space. Body text in B is also small.
